intended_object: For a homomorphism of group schemes i : H → G over S, the canonical quotient map G → G/H. Here G is viewed through its functor of points and G/H is the fppf sheafification of the presheaf of left cosets T ↦ G(T)/i(H(T)). Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and Milne, Algebraic Groups, §5.
explanation:
The definition takes two steps:
- First it applies the pointwise coset projection `yonedaCosetMk i`. On each T this sends g ∈ G(T) to its class in G(T)/i(H(T)). The result is lifted one universe up so that sheafification exists.
- Then it composes with the unit `toSheafify` of the sheafification of the coset presheaf on the relative fppf site over S.

The source is the functor of points of G, i.e. the represented sheaf `uliftYoneda G`. The target is `relativeFppfCoset i`, which is exactly the sheafified coset presheaf. So this is the standard projection G → G/H in the category of fppf sheaves.

The docstring is accurate. It only claims local surjectivity, and the next instance proves that.

The construction is specific to the relative fppf site of schemes over S, which is the intended setting for coset quotients of group schemes. Mathlib has no general version of this coset-quotient sheaf, so the definition is not too narrow.
